summary: The player avoids firing primary weapons and instead uses a wide arc scan or pulse, weaving through formations of small pink enemies and their bullets while taking several hull hits that deplete two life bars.

events.evidence: Wide blue-white arc sweeps upward from the player ship with a soft whoosh; Cannon pip at top right empties.
Player ship banks sharply left toward the left edge of the lane.
Narrow arc pulse emitted upward from the left side.
Player ship moves back toward the center.
Wider arc sweeps across the central formation of small enemies.
Small arc pulse released on the right side.
Arc pulse released upward from lower right.
Crunch/hit sound, screen flash, top-right pink life pips drop from 4 to 3, score jumps to 100, and player ship turns into a dark ring with a black core (invulnerability/hit state).
Wide arc sweeps over the upper group of enemies.
Small arc hits the rightmost enemy; '53%' and then '100%' scan/progress label appears and 'Codex: Scout' banner pops up.
Arc sweeps across the cluster of enemies in the middle; percentage labels ('31%', '53%') appear on them.
Small arc released on the right side.
Player moves left into the middle of the enemy cluster.
Wide arc fired upward at point-blank range.
Player collides with enemy/bullets at bottom center; crunch sound, pink life pips drop from 3 to 2, score increases by 100 to 229.
Wide arc sweeps upward right after the hit.

readability_issues.issue: Small pink circular bullets and small pink oval enemies share nearly identical magenta/pink glowing palettes, making it hard to tell whether the player was hit by a bullet or collided with an enemy hull.

The bright white player glow, scan arc, and floating percentage labels ('23%', '47%') overlap directly with enemies and bullets at close range, obscuring hazards right before the player takes a hit at 9.8s.
